title.zh: 10月6日15:07 UTC再核：伤亡分项未更新
title.en: 6 Oct 15:07 UTC recheck: split casualties unchanged

body.zh: 本轮再核新华社、gov.cn与@XHNews/@CCTV_Plus：中方仍为截至9月5日18时，43死、519失联、救出2人。应急管理部9月17日合计562人死亡失踪、仍在核查，不替代分项。尼方KPI仍用PTI引10月5日NDRRMA：1455死、5285失踪、13795获救。epardafas同日5时称找回遗体1457具，不替代理事会口径。堰塞湖仍为新华社9月5日已排空。交通厅路网页更新至9月28日，G216仍双向管制。美使馆道路告示仍为9月3日。无新UNOSAT/Copernicus EMS激活。无新队伍坐标。
body.en: Recheck of Xinhua, gov.cn and @XHNews/@CCTV_Plus: CN remains as of 5 Sep 18:00, 43 dead, 519 missing, 2 rescued. MEM 17 Sep combined 562 dead and missing, still under verification, does not replace the split. NP KPI stays the PTI-cited NDRRMA figures of 5 Oct: 1455 dead, 5285 missing, 13795 rescued. epardafas the same day reported 1457 bodies recovered and does not replace the council figure. Barrier lake remains Xinhua 5 Sep drained. The transport page is now 28 Sep and still lists two-way control on G216. US Embassy road notice remains 3 Sep. No new UNOSAT/Copernicus EMS activation. No new team coordinates.
body.ne: Xinhua/gov.cn/@XHNews/@CCTV_Plus: CN 5 Sep 18:00 43/519/2. MEM 17 Sep 562 jod, verify baki. NP KPI PTI/NDRRMA 5 Oct: 1455/5285/13795. epardafas 1457 body, council badaldaina. Tal Xinhua 5 Sep khali. G216 page 28 Sep niyantran. US Embassy 3 Sep. Naya UNOSAT/Copernicus EMS chaina. GNSS chaina.
body.hi: Xinhua/gov.cn/@XHNews/@CCTV_Plus: CN 5 Sep 18:00 43/519/2. MEM 17 Sep 562 jod, verification baaki. NP KPI PTI/NDRRMA 5 Oct: 1455/5285/13795. epardafas 1457 body, council nahi badalta. Jheel Xinhua 5 Sep khali. G216 page 28 Sep niyantran. US Embassy 3 Sep. Naya UNOSAT/Copernicus EMS nahi. GNSS nahi.

title.zh: 交通厅9月28日：G216吉隆镇—国门仍双向管制
title.en: Transport dept 28 Sep: G216 town-gate still controlled
title.ne: Transport 28 Sep: G216 dui tira niyantran
title.hi: Transport 28 Sep: G216 dono disha niyantran

body.zh: 西藏自治区交通运输厅路网（9月27日18时至9月28日18时）：G216 K3500+200（吉隆镇）—K3525+850（吉隆国门）自8月26日起双向交通管制，解除时间待定。抢险通道不等于社会车辆放行。
body.en: Xizang transport bulletin covering 27-28 Sep: G216 K3500+200 (Gyirong town) to K3525+850 (gate) remains two-way controlled since 26 Aug; lift time unset. The rescue track is not public reopening.
body.ne: Xizang transport 27-28 Sep: G216 K3500+200-K3525+850 26 Aug dekhi dui tira niyantran. Rescue bato sadharan khulne hoina.
body.hi: Xizang transport 27-28 Sep: G216 K3500+200-K3525+850 26 Aug se dono disha niyantran. Rescue path sadharan khulna nahi.

title.zh: 10月5日：国家减灾理事会结束大规模搜救
title.en: 5 Oct: national council ends mass SAR
title.ne: 5 Oct: rastriya parishad le thulo khoj rokeko
title.hi: 5 Oct: rashtriya parishad ne bada khoj roka

body.zh: PTI：总理沙阿主持第21次国家减灾理事会，决定除必要行动外结束40天搜救，转向博特科西—特里舒里重建，并建议约559.17亿卢比、504项计划。所引NDRRMA：1455死、5285失踪、13795获救；临时安置1226人。无新队伍坐标。
body.en: PTI: PM Shah chaired the 21st national DRR council and decided to end the 40-day search except essential work, shifting to Bhotekoshi-Trishuli reconstruction, and recommended about NPR 559.17 billion for 504 plans. Cited NDRRMA: 1455 dead, 5285 missing, 13795 rescued; 1226 in temporary accommodation. No new team coordinates.
body.ne: PTI: PM Shah ko 21st council le 40-din khoj rokeko, avashyak bahyek. NPR 559.17 arba. NDRRMA 1455/5285/13795. Holding 1226. GNSS chaina.
body.hi: PTI: PM Shah ki 21st council ne 40-din khoj roka, zaroori chhodkar. NPR 559.17 arb. NDRRMA 1455/5285/13795. Holding 1226. GNSS nahi.

title.zh: 10月5日5时：报道称已找回遗体1457具

body.zh: epardafas：截至10月5日5时，八区找回1455具，加加德满都治疗中死亡2人，合计1457具。警方投入7975人。此为同日早间口径，不替代当日理事会所引NDRRMA的1455/5285/13795。无新队伍坐标。
body.en: epardafas: as of 05:00 on 5 Oct, 1455 bodies in eight districts plus 2 who died under treatment in Kathmandu, totaling 1457. Nepal Police had mobilized 7975 personnel. This morning count does not replace the same-day council-cited NDRRMA figures of 1455/5285/13795. No new team coordinates.
body.ne: epardafas: 5 Oct 05:00, 8 jilla 1455 body, Kathmandu ma 2, jod 1457. Police 7975. Council ko 1455/5285/13795 badaldaina. GNSS chaina.
body.hi: epardafas: 5 Oct 05:00, 8 zile 1455 body, Kathmandu mein 2, kul 1457. Police 7975. Council wala 1455/5285/13795 nahi badalta. GNSS nahi.

title.zh: 央视10月4日：中尼科考队从成都启程赴尼
title.en: CCTV 4 Oct: China-Nepal science team left Chengdu
title.ne: CCTV 4 Oct: science team Chengdu bata Nepal tira
title.hi: CCTV 4 Oct: science team Chengdu se Nepal ke liye

body.zh: 央视/香港01：喜马拉雅8·26应急跨境科考队50余人10月4日从成都启程赴尼，溯源冰岩崩并服务吉隆口岸重建。文中引应急管理部9月17日口径为562人死亡失踪、仍在核查，不替代9月5日分项。无现场坐标。
body.en: CCTV/HK01: 50-plus researchers left Chengdu for Nepal on 4 Oct to trace the ice-rock avalanche and support Gyirong Port reconstruction. The text cites MEM 17 Sep as 562 dead and missing, still being verified, and does not replace the 5 Sep split. No field coordinates.
body.ne: CCTV/HK01: 50+ scientist 4 Oct Chengdu bata Nepal tira. MEM 17 Sep 562 mrit/samparka bihin, verify baki. 5 Sep ank badaldaina. GNSS chaina.
body.hi: CCTV/HK01: 50+ scientist 4 Oct Chengdu se Nepal ke liye. MEM 17 Sep 562 mrit/lapata, verification baaki. 5 Sep ank nahi badalte. GNSS nahi.

title.zh: 指挥部：截至9月5日18时 43死519失联
title.en: Command: as of 5 Sep 18:00, 43 dead, 519 missing

body.zh: 吉隆应急救援指挥部：截至9月5日18时，43人遇难、519人失联、成功救出2人、遗物993件。外籍失联261人、23国。此后新华社与@XHNews未见更新分项伤亡。
body.en: Gyirong command: as of 5 Sep 18:00, 43 dead, 519 missing, 2 rescued, 993 personal effects. 261 missing foreigners from 23 countries. No later split casualty update from Xinhua or @XHNews.
body.ne: Command: 5 Sep 18:00 43 mrit, 519 samparka bihin, 2 uddar. Bideshi 261. Xinhua pachi naya split casualty chaina.
body.hi: Command: 5 Sep 18:00 43 mrit, 519 lapata, 2 uddhar. Videshi 261. Xinhua ke baad naya split casualty nahi.

title.zh: 新华社9月5日：口岸上方堰塞湖已排空
title.en: Xinhua 5 Sep: barrier lake above the port drained
title.ne: Xinhua 5 Sep: port mathi ko bandha tal khali
title.hi: Xinhua 5 Sep: port ke upar ka barrier lake khali

body.zh: 新华示引应急管理部门：口岸核心区上方堰塞湖湖水排空，河道恢复过流，险情基本解除。本轮无新堰塞湖通报。
body.en: Xinhua cites the emergency department: the lake above the port core has drained, the channel is flowing, and the hazard is largely eliminated. No later barrier-lake bulletin.
body.ne: Xinhua: tal khali, nadi sadharan, jokhim hatyo. Pachi naya tal bulletin chaina.
body.hi: Xinhua: jheel khali, nadi normal, khatra hat gaya. Baad mein naya jheel bulletin nahi.

title.zh: 美国驻尼使馆9月3日：勿前往Rasuwagadhi-Timure
title.en: US Embassy Nepal 3 Sep: do not travel Rasuwagadhi-Timure
title.hi: US Embassy 3 Sep: Rasuwagadhi-Timure mat jao

body.zh: 使馆道路告示仍为9月3日：勿前往Rasuwagadhi-Timure-Syafrubesi，正常通行未恢复。本轮未见更新告示。
body.en: Embassy road notice remains 3 Sep: do not travel to Rasuwagadhi-Timure-Syafrubesi; normal access not restored. No newer notice found.
body.ne: Embassy notice 3 Sep nai: Rasuwagadhi-Timure-Syafrubesi najau. Naya notice chaina.
body.hi: Embassy notice 3 Sep hi: Rasuwagadhi-Timure-Syafrubesi mat jao. Naya notice nahi.

title.zh: 新华社8月30日：源头在尼泊尔一侧
title.en: Xinhua 30 Aug: source on the Nepal side
title.hi: Xinhua 30 Aug: srot Nepal ki taraf

body.zh: 新华示：8月26日约10时52分，尼泊尔境内冰岩崩沿河冲击约22公里后抵达吉隆口岸，约0.7平方公里、27处建筑被夷平。此条为成因说明，不更新伤亡分项。
body.en: Xinhua: about 10:52 on 26 Aug an ice-rock avalanche in Nepal ran about 22 km to Gyirong Port, leveling about 0.7 sq km and 27 buildings. This is the cause account and does not update the casualty split.
body.ne: Xinhua: 26 Aug 10:52 Nepal ice-rock avalanche, 22 km, port 0.7 sq km. Casualty badaldaina.
body.hi: Xinhua: 26 Aug 10:52 Nepal ice-rock avalanche, 22 km, port 0.7 sq km. Casualty nahi badalta.

detail.zh: 口岸设施已毁，通关未恢复。中方关闭。本轮无重开通报。
detail.en: Port facilities destroyed; clearance not restored. Chinese side closed. No reopening notice this cycle.
detail.ne: Port dhvasta; clearance khuleko chaina. Chiniya taraf band. Yo cycle khulne notice chaina.
detail.hi: Port dhvast; clearance nahi. Chini taraf band. Is cycle khulne ka notice nahi.

detail.zh: 交通厅9月28日路网：K3500+200—K3525+850双向管制，解除时间待定。抢险通道仅救援。
detail.en: Transport bulletin 28 Sep: K3500+200-K3525+850 two-way control, lift time unset. Rescue track only.
detail.ne: 28 Sep road info: K3500+200-K3525+850 dui tira niyantran. Rescue bato matra.
detail.hi: 28 Sep road info: K3500+200-K3525+850 dono disha niyantran. Rescue path hi.

detail.zh: 美国驻尼使馆9月3日：正常通行未恢复，勿前往。本轮无新告示。
detail.en: US Embassy Nepal 3 Sep: normal access not restored; do not travel. No newer notice.
detail.ne: US Embassy 3 Sep: sadharan bato chaina; najau. Naya notice chaina.
detail.hi: US Embassy 3 Sep: normal rasta nahi; mat jao. Naya notice nahi.

detail.zh: 截至9月5日18时：核心区搜寻与消杀已覆盖。无新现场坐标。
detail.en: As of 5 Sep 18:00: core search and disinfection covered. No new live GNSS.
detail.ne: 5 Sep 18:00: core khoj cover. Naya GNSS chaina.
detail.hi: 5 Sep 18:00: core khoj cover. Naya GNSS nahi.

detail.zh: 10月5日国家减灾理事会：除必要行动外结束大规模搜救。无新队伍坐标，故不标经纬度。
detail.en: 5 Oct national council: mass SAR ended except essential work. No new team GNSS, so no lat/lng.
detail.ne: 5 Oct council: thulo khoj rokeko. Toli GNSS chaina.
detail.hi: 5 Oct council: bada khoj roka. Team GNSS nahi.

detail.zh: 10月4日50余人从成都启程赴尼溯源，非现场救援坐标，不标经纬度。
detail.en: On 4 Oct, 50-plus researchers left Chengdu for Nepal to trace the source. Not a field rescue fix, so no lat/lng.
detail.ne: 4 Oct 50+ scientist Chengdu bata Nepal tira. Field GNSS chaina.
detail.hi: 4 Oct 50+ scientist Chengdu se Nepal ke liye. Field GNSS nahi.

detail.zh: 9月5日指挥部：核心区搜寻与预防性消杀已全覆盖。救出2人。
detail.en: 5 Sep command: core-area search and preventive disinfection fully covered. 2 rescued.
detail.ne: 5 Sep command: core khoj ra disinfection cover. 2 uddar.
detail.hi: 5 Sep command: core khoj aur disinfection cover. 2 uddhar.

detail.zh: 本轮无新安置数。不编造安置人数。
detail.en: No new shelter count this cycle. Shelter numbers are not invented.
detail.ne: Yo cycle naya shelter ank chaina. Ank banako chaina.
detail.hi: Is cycle naya shelter ank nahi. Ank nahi banaya.

detail.zh: 尼方10月5日除必要行动外结束大规模搜救。通行未恢复。
detail.en: Nepal ended mass SAR on 5 Oct except essential work. Access not restored.
detail.ne: Nepal le 5 Oct thulo khoj rokeko. Bato chaina.
detail.hi: Nepal ne 5 Oct bada khoj roka. Rasta nahi.

status.zh: 新华社9月5日：口岸上方堰塞湖已排空，河道恢复过流，险情基本解除。本轮无新通报。
status.en: Xinhua 5 Sep: barrier lake above the port drained, channel flowing, hazard largely eliminated. No new bulletin this cycle.
status.ne: Xinhua 5 Sep: tal khali, nadi sadharan, jokhim hatyo. Yo cycle naya bulletin chaina.
status.hi: Xinhua 5 Sep: jheel khali, nadi normal, khatra hat gaya. Is cycle naya bulletin nahi.

text.zh: @XHNews 9月10日：国家气候中心正向尼泊尔提供滚动气候监测与预报，支持吉隆—Rasuwa口岸泥石流后救援。未更新伤亡。
text.en: @XHNews 10 Sep: the National Climate Center is sending Nepal rolling climate monitoring and forecasts to support relief after the Gyirong-Rasuwa mudslide. No casualty update.
text.ne: @XHNews 10 Sep: climate center le Nepal lai forecast pathayeko. Casualty chaina.
text.hi: @XHNews 10 Sep: climate center Nepal ko forecast bhej raha hai. Casualty update nahi.

text.zh: @CCTV_Plus 9月10日：灾后留在吉隆镇的尼泊尔务工继续工作，希望灾区尽快恢复。未给出伤亡数字。
text.en: @CCTV_Plus 10 Sep: Nepali workers who stayed in Gyirong Town after the mudslide are continuing work and hope the area recovers. No casualty figures given.
text.ne: @CCTV_Plus 10 Sep: Gyirong Town ma Nepali karmi le kaam jari. Casualty ank chaina.
text.hi: @CCTV_Plus 10 Sep: Gyirong Town mein Nepali karmchari kaam jari. Casualty ank nahi.

text.zh: 本轮检索@XHNews与@CCTV_Plus的#吉隆口岸 #吉隆泥石流 #GyirongPort #Rasuwa：9月10日以来无新帖。不编造推文。
text.en: This cycle found no new @XHNews or @CCTV_Plus posts on the Gyirong/Rasuwa tags since 10 Sep. No tweet text is invented.
text.ne: Yo cycle @XHNews/@CCTV_Plus ma 10 Sep pachi naya post chaina. Tweet banako chaina.
text.hi: Is cycle @XHNews/@CCTV_Plus par 10 Sep ke baad naya post nahi. Tweet nahi banaya.
